title: NvMServiceCaller
text: Call AUTOSAR NVRAM Manager (NvM) service interface NvMService, {Operation} sets operation defined in NvM service interface NvMService; {Client port name} sets the name of client port AUTOSAR component uses to call NvM service interface, {Argument specification} sets the data type and dimensions for operation read or write access and {Sample time} sets the block sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Client port name
params.values: Name of client port AUTOSAR component uses to call NvM service interface NvMService NvMService (default) | character vector

params.name: Operation
params.values: Specify operation defined in NvM service interface NvMService GetDataIndex (default) | GetErrorStatus | EraseNvBlock | InvalidateNvBlock | ReadBlock | RestoreBlockDefaults | SetDataIndex | SetRamBlockStatus | WriteBlock

params.name: Argument specification
params.values: Specify data type and dimensions for operation read or write access uint8(1) (default) | character vector
